bibliographic.title: Ms Teri (she’s a mystery)
bibliographic.author: Mark Carew
bibliographic.description:
This is an interactive story in the style of the old “Choose Your Own Adventure” books.

Interact with the story and see what science you learn!

The science is pitched at undergraduate level for healthcare students: nurses, pharmacists and doctors.

DISCLAIMER In the story, you take the role of a doctor. This story does not constitute medical advice and should not replace information given by a qualified healthcare professional. The story is designed to test knowledge in the manner of a case study and is intended for educational purposes only.
